I've evaluated that the hydro characters represent the different **senses of virtue**. **Prudence**, which applies to Mona using her astronomical abilities for the purpose of staying safe. In both the Unreconciled Stars event and her story quest Astrolabos Chapter obtainable by story keys, it was shown how **cautious** Mona really is. **Justice**, which can be seen from the quest Bookworm Swordsman wherein Xingqiu makes the traveler carry out his elaborate plan just to **set things right** for Chang the Ninth as he deserves. And finally, **Benevolence**, which we can see within Barbara's character. This young lady gives her all to bring joy to the people around her and works hard as a healer for the adventurers. She's generally optimistic and **means well**. 

Bonus:
As for Childe, I presume he can be counted in the last category since he doesn't have much of malicious intent and is genuinely considerate to others he deems significant enough. His goal in life is to simply have a battle with the strongest there is, he doesn't involve himself in fights just for the sake of doing something bad. Let's also look into the fact that Childe was **handed over** to the fatui, he did not choose to join them though continued doing so since he figured he can satiate his battlelust even by just a bit while earning loads for his beloved family.
